achievements.name: You Are Not Prepared!
achievements.description: Collect all eight Scholomance Tier 0.5 armour pieces and the full fixed Gandling weapon reward for each of the nine classes.

achievements.name: Stormstrike Graduation
achievements.description: As an Enhancement Shaman, defeat Darkmaster Gandling with Stormstrike as the killing blow.

achievements.name: Straight A's
achievements.description: Defeat Darkmaster Gandling without any player taking damage from Headmaster's Office or The Last Examination.

achievements.name: Yes, I am prepared!
achievements.description: Complete Scholomance on Heroic V solo with all nine classes, using each class's Tier 0.5 set bonuses and matching specialization talents.
